access_boundary: This record represents the sonar search line, served through the Perplexity Sonar API until Perplexity ended Sonar Chat Completions support on September 27, 2026, and through the Agent API as perplexity/sonar, whose model list links the same Sonar model page. The Pro, Reasoning Pro, and Deep Research siblings, retired Llama-based sonar names, the Agent API presets, and the Perplexity platform itself are separate boundaries.
strengths: Dedicated first-party page pins the model with 128K context, citations, and search grounding
Still served on the Agent API as perplexity/sonar, with first-party SDKs and OpenAI-compatible access
tradeoffs: No downloadable weights exist anywhere first-party for this model
The evergreen name carries no pinnable snapshot, and its Sonar API route lost support on September 27, 2026, leaving the Agent API as the documented path
